# encoding: utf8
from __future__ import print_function

from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, Column, Integer, String
from sqlalchemy.ext.declarative import declarative_base

Base = declarative_base()


class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'users'

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    name = Column(String)
    fullname = Column(String)
    password = Column(String)

    def __repr__(self):
        return "<User(name='%s', fullname='%s', password='%s')>" % (self.name,
                self.fullname, self.password)


engine = create_engine('sqlite:///:memory:', echo=True)
Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
Session = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
session = Session()

ed_user = User(name='ed', fullname='Ed Jones', password='edspassword')
session.add(ed_user)
session.add_all([
    User(name='wendy', fullname='Wendy Williams', password='foobar'),
    User(name='mary', fullname='Mary Contrary', password='xxg527'),
    User(name='fred', fullname='Fred Flinstone', password='blah')])
session.commit()

print(session.query(User).offset(1).limit(2).all())
# SELECT users.id AS users_id, users.name AS users_name, users.fullname AS users_fullname, \
# users.password AS users_password FROM users LIMIT 2 OFFSET 1

for row in session.query(User, User.name).all():
    print(row.User, row.name)

with session.begin(subtransactions=True):
    ed_user.name = "ed2"

session.delete(ed_user)

 * @param query - Request parameters.

async function fetchStudentGroups(context: AppContext, query: GetStudentGroupsQuery): Promise<GetStudentGroupsQueryResponse> {
    const parameters = createUrlParameters(query);
    const query_url = `${createApiUrl(context.backend_information)}/api/student-groups/`;
    const result = await axios.get<Envelope<GetStudentGroupsQueryResponse>>(
        query_url,
        { params: parameters }
    );

    if (result.status !== 200) {
        throw new Error("failed to fetch students information")
    }

    if (!result.data.body) {
        throw new Error("failed to fetch students information")
    }

    return result.data.body;
}

/**

 * @param query - Request parameters.
 * @returns Response containing group and student information.
 */
async function fetchStudentsOfGroup(context: AppContext, query: GetStudentOfGroupsQuery): Promise<GetStudentOfGroupsResponse> {
    const parameters = createUrlParametersFromStudentsOfGroupQuery(query);
    const query_url = `${createApiUrl(context.backend_information)}/api/student-groups/${query.groupId}/students/`;
    const result = await axios.get<Envelope<GetStudentOfGroupsResponse>>(
        query_url,
        { params: parameters }
    );

    if (result.status !== 200) {
        throw new Error("failed to fetch students information")
    }

    if (!result.data.body) {
        throw new Error("failed to fetch students information")
    }

    return result.data.body;
}

function createUrlParametersFromStudentsOfGroupQuery(query: GetStudentOfGroupsQuery): URLSearchParams {
    const params: URLSearchParams = new URLSearchParams()
    addPaginationParametersToURLSearchParams(params, query.pagination);
    appendSortParametersToURLSearchParams(params, query.sorting);

    if (query.filters.text_search_filter) {
        params.append("text_search_filter", query.filters.text_search_filter.toString())
    }

    return params;
}

function createUrlParameters(query: GetStudentGroupsQuery): URLSearchParams {
    const params: URLSearchParams = new URLSearchParams()
    params.append("page", query.pagination.page.toString())
    params.append("per_page", query.pagination.per_page.toString());

    if (query.filters.include_archived) {
        params.append("include_archived", query.filters.include_archived.toString())
    }

    if (query.filters.text_search_filter) {
        params.append("text_search_filter", query.filters.text_search_filter.toString())
    }

    appendSortParametersToURLSearchParams(params, query.sorting);
    return params;
}
